night134.title: Bridge Over Water at Night
night134.description: A long exposure photograph captures a brightly lit bridge spanning across a dark body of water at night. The bridge's numerous lights reflect as shimmering streaks on the water's surface, creating a warm glow. The sky above is a deep, dark blue, with faint hints of distant city lights on the horizon.

night141.title: Milky Way Hoodoos
night141.description: A wide-angle, low-light photograph captures a dramatic night sky filled with countless stars and the faint, glowing band of the Milky Way stretching diagonally across the upper right. Below, a landscape of light-colored, eroded rock formations, known as hoodoos, rises from the ground. The most prominent hoodoo stands tall and slender in the mid-ground, topped with a dark, mushroom-like cap, while other smaller hoodoos and textured, rippled rock formations fill the foreground and mid-ground. A large, lighter-colored cliff face dominates the left side of the frame, contrasting with the dark, star-studded sky.

night144.title: Night Road Under Stars
night144.description: A dark, winding road illuminated by yellow streetlights and the faint glow of distant light pollution, under a clear night sky filled with countless stars. Bare trees line both sides of the road, their branches silhouetted against the deep blue sky. Several yellow chevron signs with reflective panels are visible on the right side of the road, indicating a curve.

night151.title: Milky Way Night Landscape
night151.description: A stunning long-exposure night photograph captures the Milky Way galaxy stretching diagonally across a dark, star-filled sky. Below, a dark silhouette of tree-covered hills and a grassy field are illuminated by a strong orange glow from distant light pollution, which also reflects in a calm body of water in the foreground. A bright orange airplane contrail streaks across the upper left sky, adding a man-made element to the vast natural scene.

night168.title: Dallas Skyline at Night
night168.description: A nighttime long-exposure shot of the Dallas, Texas skyline. The prominent Reunion Tower, topped with its distinctive geodesic dome, glows brightly in the center-left. The Bank of America Plaza building to its left is outlined in vibrant green lights. The rest of the city's buildings are illuminated with warm yellow and orange lights, and the streaks of car headlights and taillights are visible on the highway in the foreground.

night250.title: Graffiti Car Under Stars
night250.description: A long exposure night shot shows a heavily graffitied, rusted car body illuminated with colorful lights, sitting in a grassy field under a dark, star-filled sky. A building with more graffiti is visible to the left, and a power line stretches across the sky. The car's interior glows purple, and its front grille and fenders are lit with green and red.

night251.title: Dramatic Lightning Strike
night251.description: A dramatic nighttime photograph captures a powerful lightning bolt illuminating a stormy sky above a suburban landscape. On the left, two houses with warm exterior lights glow under dark, cloudy skies, with a car parked in front of one. On the right, a brilliant, jagged blue-white lightning strike descends from the dark clouds, casting an intense purple-blue glow across the sky and silhouetting a large tree.

night252.title: Bug Spiders at Night
night252.description: Four Volkswagen Beetle shells, painted orange and black, are arranged in a grassy field under a starry night sky. They are modified to resemble spiders, with black metal 'legs' extending from their sides. The interiors of the cars are illuminated with different colored lights: the largest car in the foreground has red lights, the next has blue, the third has green, and the smallest in the distance has red. The horizon shows a faint glow of light pollution.

night253.title: Starry Jailhouse
night253.description: A small, rustic stone building, resembling an old jail cell with a heavy barred door, stands under a vast, star-filled night sky. A prickly pear cactus grows on its roof, and the building is illuminated with a warm, orange light, contrasting with the deep blue and purple hues of the starry expanse above. Bare trees are visible in the distant left, adding to the isolated and historic feel of the scene.

night254.title: Milky Way Over Cliffs
night254.description: A dramatic vertical shot of a dark night sky densely packed with stars, including the faint, cloudy band of the Milky Way stretching diagonally across the upper right. Below, a towering, light-colored cliff face with vertical striations rises from a dark, rocky, and sparsely vegetated slope. A warm orange glow from distant light pollution is visible on the horizon to the left, while a large, reddish-brown rock sits in the immediate foreground.

night255.title: Starry Night Cabin
night255.description: A wide-angle, low-light photograph captures a rustic wooden cabin with a tin roof and stone chimney under a vast, star-filled night sky. A large, bare-branched tree stands prominently to the right, its dark silhouette contrasting with the bright stars. The horizon shows a faint glow from light pollution, and a few wispy clouds are visible in the sky. The overall mood is serene and isolated.

night256.title: Milky Way Desert Night
night256.description: A long exposure photograph captures a gnarled, bare tree in the foreground, illuminated to reveal its intricate branches against a dark desert landscape. In the mid-ground, several large, rounded rock formations are silhouetted. The night sky above is a deep blue-black, showcasing the Milky Way on the left and streaky, motion-blurred clouds on the right, creating a dynamic and serene scene.

night257.title: Starry Night Church
night257.description: A white, rural church with a dark green steeple and a cross stands prominently against a vast, dark blue night sky. The sky is densely populated with countless stars, including visible star clusters and faint light streaks, creating a serene and majestic celestial backdrop above the dimly lit building and dark foreground field.

night258.title: Pink Lights Canal Night
night258.description: A wide-angle nighttime photograph captures a serene urban canal illuminated by a winding path of glowing pink and purple lights submerged in its dark water. On the left, a paved walkway is bordered by lush green trees and distant buildings with warm lights. To the right, a modern brick and glass building with large, angled support columns stands under a dark blue sky featuring a bright crescent moon and faint stars. The water reflects the vibrant lights and surrounding structures.

night260.title: Chaco Canyon Night Sky
night260.description: An ancient stone pueblo structure, illuminated by a warm orange light, stands under a dark blue night sky filled with countless white stars. The ruins show multiple levels and window-like openings, with a gravel path leading into a shadowed area on the right. The overall mood is serene and historical.

night261.title: Bond Street Dead End
night261.description: A nighttime photo shows a 'Bond St.' street sign and a 'Dead End' sign on a dirt road, leading to an old, dilapidated wooden house surrounded by dry brush and trees. The sky above is a deep blue, filled with countless stars, creating a serene yet eerie atmosphere.

night262.title: Wind Turbine Night Sky
night262.description: A tall wind turbine stands silhouetted against a dark night sky filled with countless stars. The turbine's blades are in motion, creating a blurred effect, and a bright red light emanates from its hub, casting a glow on the rotating blades. The lower portion of the image shows a faint yellow-orange glow on the horizon, suggesting distant light pollution, with the ground and other structures in silhouette.

night264.title: Starry Night Moonrise
night264.description: A wide, horizontal shot of a dark night sky filled with countless stars, transitioning to a warm orange glow near the horizon. Two large, bare trees with intricate branches are silhouetted in the foreground, framing a bright, golden-orange moon rising or setting between them. The moon casts a soft light on the distant silhouetted treeline, creating a serene and vast natural landscape.

night265.title: Abandoned Church Night Sky
night265.description: An old, weathered wooden church stands under a dark, star-filled night sky. The church has a tall, square bell tower and a front entrance with a broken door. The wood siding is faded and peeling, illuminated by a warm, artificial light source from the left, casting long shadows. The ground around the church is dry and sparse, with hints of distant light pollution on the horizon to the left and a red glow to the right. The overall mood is serene yet slightly eerie.

night266.title: Industrial Night Sky
night266.description: A low-angle, wide shot captures the imposing silhouettes of industrial structures against a deep blue, star-filled night sky. On the left, a tall, intricate metal framework supports various pipes and platforms, while on the right, a massive, cylindrical silo dominates the frame. The structures are dimly lit with warm, orange-brown tones, highlighting their weathered textures and casting long shadows, creating a dramatic and somewhat eerie atmosphere.

night267.title: Starry Mountain Valley Night
night267.description: A breathtaking wide shot captures a snow-covered mountain valley at night, illuminated by a brilliant starry sky and warm artificial lights. Dark, forested slopes frame a winding valley floor where a road or railway line is visible, dusted with snow. Clusters of bright lights from buildings cast an orange glow on the surrounding pine trees and snowy terrain, creating a serene and enchanting winter scene.

night268.title: Night Sky Pillars
night268.description: A long exposure photograph of a night sky filled with countless white stars, transitioning from a vibrant purple-blue at the top to a dark navy near the horizon. Two prominent, parallel, dark vertical bands stretch from the top of the frame downwards, appearing as shadows or obscured areas against the starry backdrop. At the bottom, a strip of dry grass meets the horizon, where scattered red, green, and bright yellow artificial lights glow in the distance.

night269.title: Milky Way Over Lake
night269.description: A breathtaking astrophotography image shows the Milky Way galaxy as a luminous, vertical band of stars and cosmic dust against a dark, star-filled night sky. Below the celestial display, a dark, textured foreground of rocks leads to a calm body of water, with faint silhouettes of distant mountains on the horizon. The scene is serene and vast.

night270.title: Highway Light Trails
night270.description: A long-exposure photograph captures the vibrant light trails of vehicles on a complex highway interchange at night. White streaks of light from headlights flow along the left side of the image, while red streaks from taillights dominate the right, curving upwards and to the right. Multiple elevated concrete overpasses crisscross the frame, illuminated by warm streetlights, creating a layered, intricate structure. Green highway signs are visible, one on the left indicating 'Midpark Rd', 'Spring Valley Rd', and 'Belt Line Rd - Main St' with distances, and another on the right showing 'Managed HOV Lane 75 North Exit 22' and '635 West' and '635 East' signs further back.

night271.title: Night Highway Lake
night271.description: A long exposure photograph captures a highway running alongside a lake at night. The dark blue sky is dotted with stars and streaky clouds. A bright, golden light trail from a vehicle's headlights stretches across the highway, reflecting a shimmering golden path on the dark water of the lake. A dark, rugged mountain covered in sparse vegetation rises steeply behind the highway.

night272.title: Church Under Milky Way
night272.description: A long exposure photograph captures a brick church with a steeple and cross under a vast, star-filled night sky. The Milky Way galaxy is prominently visible on the right, while the church is dimly lit, revealing its architectural details and a dark tree on the left. The stars appear as short trails due to the long exposure, creating a serene and majestic nocturnal scene.

night273.title: Twilight River Valley
night273.description: A serene, long-exposure landscape photograph captures a river flowing through a dark mountain valley at twilight. Steep, tree-covered mountains flank the river, with the left side in deep silhouette and the right revealing rocky textures. The deep blue sky above features soft, streaky clouds, and the river's surface reflects the subtle light, creating shimmering, smooth patterns.

night274.title: Britten Water Tower Stars
night274.description: A tall, white and rust-colored water tower, with 'BRITTEN' written on its tank, stands in a field of dry, golden-brown grass. Above it, a dark night sky is densely populated with countless bright stars. Distant artificial lights glow faintly on the horizon, adding to the serene, rural nighttime atmosphere.

night275.title: Starry Night Waterfall
night275.description: A long exposure photograph captures a multi-tiered waterfall cascading down a rocky, moss-covered mountainside under a dark blue, star-filled night sky. Tall, dark evergreen trees silhouette against the sky at the top of the mountain, while the blurred, milky white water of the falls contrasts with the dark, rugged terrain illuminated by an unseen light source, creating a serene and magical atmosphere.

night276.title: Abandoned Under Stars
night276.description: An old, abandoned, single-story building with crumbling walls, broken windows, and a partially collapsed roof stands under a vast, star-filled night sky. Warm light from the left illuminates the building's facade and the dry grass in the foreground, while dark trees frame the scene on either side. The deep black sky above is densely packed with countless white and faint blue stars, creating a serene and slightly eerie atmosphere.

night277.title: Tram Night Ride
night277.description: The interior of a vintage tram at night, viewed from the driver's perspective. The foreground shows the control panel with a large brass steering wheel on the right, a pressure gauge, and a tall, reddish-brown cylindrical object on the left. Through the front and side windows, the outside world is a blur of streaking yellow, blue, and white lights, indicating motion and speed, creating a dynamic and slightly nostalgic mood.

night278.title: Green Meteor Light Trails
night278.description: A long exposure photograph captures a dramatic night scene with a dark sky full of stars and a brilliant green meteor streaking diagonally across the upper right. Below, a highway shows long white light trails from headlights on the left and red taillight trails on the right, indicating moving traffic. Distant hills are silhouetted against the horizon, with scattered artificial lights from roadside structures.

night279.title: Starry Wind Turbine
night279.description: A long-exposure night photograph captures a tall white wind turbine with its blades blurred into a star-like pattern, glowing with red lights at its hub. The dark, starry sky above transitions to a warm orange glow of distant light pollution near the horizon, where numerous other wind turbines with red warning lights are visible as silhouettes. The foreground shows a dark expanse of land with sparse trees and a utility pole.

night280.title: Stiles Cemetery Stars
night280.description: An astrophotography image captures a vast, star-filled night sky, with the Milky Way visible, above the silhouetted entrance to Stiles Cemetery. In the foreground, an arched metal sign reads "STILES CEMETERY," flanked by tall, slender trees and a barbed wire fence on the left. A soft, orange glow from the horizon illuminates the lower portion of the sky.

night281.title: Starry Night Landscape
night281.description: A wide-angle photograph captures a dark night sky teeming with countless stars, including the faint band of the Milky Way visible on the right. Two brilliant celestial objects, likely planets, shine brightly on the left, casting a warm glow over a vast, snow-dusted landscape with distant silhouetted mountains. The scene evokes a sense of cold, quiet majesty under an expansive sky.
